import sys

data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
n = data[0]
grid = [data[1 + i * n:1 + (i + 1) * n] for i in range(n)]

target = next(sum(row) for row in grid if 0 not in row)
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if grid[i][j] == 0:
            print(target - sum(grid[i]), i + 1, j + 1, sep="\n")
            break
